# listmonk_user_role (Resource)

Manages a listmonk user role: a named set of global permissions assigned to users. The built-in Super Admin role (ID 1) cannot be managed.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "listmonk_user_role" "campaign_manager" {
  name = "Campaign manager"
  permissions = [
    "campaigns:get_all",
    "campaigns:manage_all",
    "campaigns:send",
    "templates:get",
    "media:get",
    "media:manage",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the role.
- `permissions` (Set of String) Permissions, e.g. `campaigns:get_all`, `subscribers:manage`, `templates:get`. The server rejects unknown permissions; see the listmonk documentation for the full list.

### Read-Only

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the role.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# User roles are imported by their numeric ID.
terraform import listmonk_user_role.campaign_manager 3
```
